name: PLATO Infeasible SDP Benchmark
description: Evaluates SDP solvers on detecting infeasibility and weak infeasibility across 800 test problems (8 families × 100 cases each). Problem families include clean and messy infeasible SDPs and weak infeasibility variants, at matrix sizes 10×10 and 20×10. The benchmark specifically tests a notoriously difficult capability: reliably detecting weak infeasibility, where standard certificates may not exist.
typical_sota_score: SDPA achieved 100% detection rate overall; PENSDP detected zero weak infeasibility cases. Other solvers vary widely.
reputation: Specialised and important benchmark for an underexplored SDP solver capability; maintained by Hans Mittelmann.
notes: Not an LLM benchmark. Weak infeasibility is particularly challenging as standard Farkas-type certificates may not apply. 800 total problems across 8 families.
